author: Google DeepMind
description:
Go behind the scenes of our recent Genie 4 film as we explore our most realistic and interactive world model yet. 

Instead of generating static video, Genie 4 simulates dynamic worlds in real time. Watch how our team used Genie 4 and Project Genie to turn text prompts into explorable environments in seconds, navigate scenes with keyboard controls, and direct action on the fly with live prompts. Using the built-in agent in Project Genie, the team also built custom apps mapped to keyboard hotkeys—triggering character movement, dialogue, and events in real time—and used prompts as repeatable seeds for everything from creative prototyping to robotics training environments.

Genie 4 is now available in Project Genie, starting with eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers.

Team: Google DeepMind, Special Guest 

Learn more about Genie 4: https://deepmind.google/genie

title: Behind the scenes with Genie 4

author: Google DeepMind
description:
Step inside your imagination with Project Genie, now powered by Google DeepMind’s most realistic and interactive world model yet, Genie 4.

Project Genie brings our most advanced world and multimodal models together with Gemini so you can turn ideas into explorable, shareable worlds right in your browser:

• Shape worlds in real time with Genie 4: Trigger dynamic events using natural language—like shifting the weather, introducing new characters, or changing the action mid-session—complete with simulated physics, natural lighting, and native scene-matched audio and character dialogue.

• Build with the Project Genie agent: Describe the story or simulation you want to create, and the new agent generates starting visuals and custom background music, while Gemini observes in-session to suggest or trigger live events.

• Explore & remix the community gallery: Jump into curated and community-built worlds, remix their environments, rules, and audio, or experiment with upgraded Genie 3 capab
title: Project Genie: Create and explore interactive worlds with Genie 4
